title: Multiple error messages in logs using 8G sensor
symptom: After switching to an 8Gxxxx transmitter and running the 08-October nightly, BG readings are obtained but the Error and Events list shows 2 or 3 errors with every reading.
fix: Update to February 17, 2021, after which the logs will not show up any longer.
evidence_quote: Those logs are expected. They will not show up any longer if you update to February 17, 2021.
